semiconductor_relevance: High — Nippon Express Holding provides logistics solutions specifically tailored for the semiconductor industry, covering the entire supply chain from procurement to production.
summary: Nippon Express Holding offers comprehensive logistics services for the semiconductor sector, including transportation, warehousing, and delivery operations. Their solutions are designed to optimize supply chain management and ensure the safe handling of sensitive semiconductor materials.
capabilities: End-to-end logistics solutions for semiconductor supply chains
Vibration protection products for semiconductor wafers
Custom transportation solutions with shock-absorbing technology

regional_presence.Japan: Nippon Express Holding is headquartered in Japan and has a significant presence in the logistics sector.
